plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, tells how the great American novelist Mark Twain was born on November 30, 1835, just as Halley's Comet, a comet that returns about every 76 years, was passing Earth. Michels says Twain often told people he expected to go out with the comet when it came back, and that, just as he predicted, he died in 1910. Michels uses it to suggest the mind may somehow sense the future.
